correctness.rationale: A triple of prescribed positive points is either noncollinear, permitting <=3 two-parallel-line unions, or collinear, forcing a shared containing line and mutually disjoint choices of the second parallel line; in either case its conditional Littlestone dimension <=1. Three iterations of the positive-branch recurrence yield global Ldim <=4. For q>=4 a support with three selected points on L, a fourth unused point on L, and one transverse selected point realizes all 16 traces by choosing two parallel lines or two distinct non-L directions. At q=2 concepts all equal the point set; at q=3 every two-line union is a complement of one line, with both dimensions 2. Proof uses affine axioms only, including non-Desarguesian planes; packaged finite-field verifier is corroboration, not the universal proof.
